# Helvety

> Helvety software products engineered, designed and made in Switzerland. Private, simple, clean. Web apps, legal pages, and Store links for the full product line.

## Canonical URLs
- [Home](https://helvety.com): Main landing page
- [Privacy Policy](https://helvety.com/privacy): Current privacy policy
- [Terms of Service](https://helvety.com/terms): Terms governing service use
- [Impressum](https://helvety.com/impressum): Legal company information

## Crawling And Indexing
- Public pages are intended to be indexable by search and AI crawlers.
- Private app routes are not intended as search index targets and use noindex and auth-gated controls.

## Agent And Crawler Guides
Per-zone `llms.txt` summaries (discoverable via robots.txt and gateway links):
- [Helvety Store](https://helvety.com/store/llms.txt)
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf/llms.txt)
- [Helvety Image Upscaler](https://helvety.com/image-upscaler/llms.txt)
- [Helvety Image Editor](https://helvety.com/image-editor/llms.txt)
- [Helvety OCR](https://helvety.com/ocr/llms.txt)
- [Helvety Auth](https://helvety.com/auth/llms.txt)
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/contacts/llms.txt)
- [Helvety Notes](https://helvety.com/notes/llms.txt)
- [Helvety Links](https://helvety.com/links/llms.txt)
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/tasks/llms.txt)

## Cookies And Storage
- Helvety web zones use essential and authentication cookies and browser storage for preferences and encrypted vault sessions. We do not use third-party analytics or advertising trackers. Full disclosure: [Privacy Policy §9](https://helvety.com/privacy#cookies).

## Related apps and tools
- [Helvety Store](https://helvety.com/store): Product specs, SPFx and other Store-hosted downloads, and install links (for example Chrome Web Store) from the catalog
- [Helvety SPO Explorer](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-spo-explorer): SharePoint site switcher in the header
- [Power Platform Configurator](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-power-platform-configurator): Configure Power Automate cloud flows: Classic or New Designer. Hide the survey prompt by default. Pause anytime. Survey tab: optional v3survey control. Hide (default) sets false on rewrites; Show only normalizes when already present. Paused: no URL rewrites while the extension stays installed. Install from the Chrome Web Store: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/power-platform-configurat/mdneakhceachnimmejciaehnfjfabang
- [Helvety Screen Tools](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-screen-tools): Windows screenshots and on-screen drawing
- [Helvety Browser Extension](https://helvety.com/store/products/helvety-browser-extension): Open beta Chromium side panel for your encrypted Helvety tasks, notes, contacts, links, and folders; manual install from GitHub releases while it is not yet in the Chrome Web Store
- [Helvety PDF](https://helvety.com/pdf): Merge, reorder, rotate, and extract PDF pages in the browser
- [Helvety Image Upscaler](https://helvety.com/image-upscaler): Upscale images in the browser on your device
- [Helvety Image Editor](https://helvety.com/image-editor): Annotate PNG, JPEG, or WebP in your browser on your device with text, arrows, borders, spotlight highlights, blur regions, and crop with adjustable stroke, blur, and corner radius; layers panel and zoom; no image upload to Helvety servers in the normal flow
- [Helvety OCR](https://helvety.com/ocr): Extract text from PDFs and images in your browser on your device; scanned pages run on-device OCR and born-digital PDFs reuse their text layer; read, copy, or download plain text with no file upload to Helvety servers
- [Helvety Contacts](https://helvety.com/contacts): Encrypted address book with export tooling
- [Helvety Notes](https://helvety.com/notes): Encrypted notes in Personal, Work, and Other groups
- [Helvety Links](https://helvety.com/links): Encrypted bookmarks in nested folders
- [Helvety Tasks](https://helvety.com/tasks): Encrypted stage-based task board

## Licensing
The helvety.com monorepo is released under AGPL-3.0-or-later. Separately distributed Helvety product repositories may use different open-source licenses, including MIT, so always check the LICENSE file in the specific repository or release source link.

## Source
- [GitHub - helvety.com monorepo](https://github.com/CasparRubin/helvety): Web applications and shared packages (AGPL-3.0)
